diagram_candidates.kind: optional TikZ directed-to-undirected Hamiltonian-path gadget map
diagram_candidates.why_warranted: The proof uses a concrete orientation-sensitive replacement: each internal directed vertex v becomes v1-v2-v3, with an input arc u→v becoming the undirected edge u3-v1. A small map can make the correspondence between directed path order and forced traversal through each triple easier to check.
diagram_candidates.content_to_draw: For the s≠t case only, depict a directed arc u→v and its output link u3—v1; show one internal triple v1—v2—v3, with the forced left-to-right traversal. Mark s3 and t1 as endpoint vertices. State that the separate s=t boundary case is handled in prose.
diagram_candidates.mathematical_status: The source map and inverse path argument are consistent on inspection. Diagram value is editorial and uncertain; it is not needed for the proof.

diagram_candidates.why_warranted: The hardness construction explicitly maps valid machine configurations to vertices, legal transitions to directed arcs, and every accepting configuration to a fresh target. A small schematic could clarify how an accepting computation branch becomes a directed path to that target.
diagram_candidates.content_to_draw: Show a start configuration, a short directed sequence of legal-configuration transitions, branching as appropriate, several accepting configurations each pointing to the fresh target t_x, and a nonaccepting branch with no target edge. Label the drawing schematic and not an exhaustive configuration graph.
diagram_candidates.mathematical_status: The proof states the path/accepting-branch equivalence directly and the map is consistent on inspection. Editorial value is uncertain; no diagram is required.
